items.function: Converter for the accelerometer; optical index
items.requirement: Delay variation at most 1.244 µs at 1,092 Hz (65,535 rpm): the optical index's share of V225. None of the 9 reflective sensors round 1 searched meets it; they state 10 to 70 µs. R10 is read for its share of the same budget. Answered under Raised by P1: V225: 1° at the highest rpm, whole chain, V202's converter share inside it: 2.54 µs of delay variation at 65,535 rpm, 16.7 µs at 10,000 rpm (owner, 2026-09-28). The delay variation is the drift of one unit between runs: the trial run cancels each unit's fixed delay, its unit-to-unit spread included (docs/Balance.md), with the filter capacitance CX at 4.7 nF or more, the datasheets' recommended minimum (owner, 2026-10-02)

items.requirement: ADXL316WBCSZ fails only its lead length in FU-2C: 2 m (V222) without a buffer, and that refutation has no ruling, because the adjudicator failed twice on an account limit. The lead buffer sits on the sensor board before the lead of up to 2 m; its delay variation and the sensor's fit inside the accelerometer's 1.244 µs share of V225 at 65,535 rpm, and R10's ADCS7476AIMFX/NOPB needs a reservoir capacitor or a buffer at its input. Answered under Raised by P1: V225: 1° at the highest rpm, whole chain, V202's converter share inside it: 2.54 µs of delay variation at 65,535 rpm, 16.7 µs at 10,000 rpm (owner, 2026-09-28). The delay variation is the drift of one unit between runs: the trial run cancels each unit's fixed delay, its unit-to-unit spread included (docs/Balance.md), with the filter capacitance CX at 4.7 nF or more, the datasheets' recommended minimum (owner, 2026-10-02)
